WITH matched_counts AS (
  SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM orders AS o
  INNER JOIN riskandmargin AS r
    ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
), average_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count
  FROM matched_counts
)
SELECT AVG(mc.order_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(mc.order_count - ac.avg_count) AS average_excess
FROM matched_counts AS mc
CROSS JOIN average_count AS ac
WHERE mc.order_count > ac.avg_count;
